implementation_change.description: Validate only the completed observable session prefix, reuse the frozen economic wealth path, calculate H1/H3 returns only when mature, bind each partial result to its exact horizon facts, retain H5-only barrier publication, and propagate completed-prefix defects by first affected horizon.

old_implementation.observed_behavior: A genuine H1 or H3 bundle validated unobserved future H2-H5 sessions and returned false STATUS_UNRESOLVED / NOT_LABEL_SAFE values.

root_cause: ReferenceLabelEngine validated the entire H1-H5 outcome window before applying per-field horizon maturity.
